Package main.java.progOO2.p16

package main.java.progOO2.p16

Programming Object Oriented II: PaymentCard

This package introduces object-oriented design with fields, constructors, methods with parameters, and state updates. The PaymentCard class models a simple prepaid card that can be used to pay for meals and reload balance with restrictions.

Key learning goals:

  • Encapsulation: The balance field is private, ensuring controlled updates.
  • Method parameters: The addMoney(double amount) method shows how to validate and limit input to avoid invalid states.
  • Conditional logic: Methods eatAffordably() and eatHeartily() deduct only if balance allows.
  • Constraints: The balance cannot exceed 150 euros, demonstrating business rules in method implementation.

This exercise helps students practice combining constructors, parameters, conditions, and encapsulation to simulate real-world constraints in programming.
